ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters limited to the distal tips and sparse surface anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pigmented lobes with high-contrast, multi-tonal (white/tan) clusters located at the left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression at the central junction with an approximate angle of 90 degrees and moderate depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, irregular low-amplitude serrations and peaks along the trailing edge of both lobes, notably on the left trailing edge segment.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitting the trailing edges from the central median notch to the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast pixels (barnacle colonization) at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal high-intensity linear mark on the left lobe; secondary shorter linear disruptions visible in the medial-left region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization at distal tips and visible white linear scars on the left lobe pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, high-intensity punctate marks (dots) scattered across the otherwise dark ventral surface.
